_comment: Mutations for the runs list, the org timezone, and the three ports they lean on: CPython's fromisoformat, zoneinfo's lookup, and pydantic's integer parsing.

mutations.name: the since filter is ignored
since is compared without converting to UTC
a Z is not read as UTC
an overflowing since is a 400 like any other bad value
the trigger filter is ignored
the total counts every run, not the filtered set
mutations.old: let count_sql = format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sentinel_runs{filters}");
mutations.new: let count_sql = String::from("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sentinel_runs WHERE org_id = $1");

mutations.name: runs are listed oldest first
mutations.old: ORDER BY triggered_at DESC OFFSET {offset} LIMIT {limit}
mutations.new: ORDER BY triggered_at ASC OFFSET {offset} LIMIT {limit}

mutations.name: the tool trace is included in the list
stats count across every org
mutations.old: let runs_total: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sentinel_runs WHERE org_id = $1")
mutations.new: let runs_total: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sentinel_runs WHERE $1 = $1")

mutations.name: running runs are not counted as pending
remaining can go negative
an offset past i64 is quietly clamped
today starts at UTC midnight regardless of the org's zone
the org's timezone setting is not read
an unknown zone is an error rather than UTC
mutations.old:
Err(crate::zoneinfo::LoadError::NotFound) => crate::zoneinfo::load("UTC")
            .map_err(|_| ApiError::internal("no UTC zone on this machine"))?,

mutations.name: a zone directory falls back to UTC instead of failing
the tzdata package's directories are not recognised
a zone name is not validated as a relative path
midnight ignores which side of a fold now is on
now's own offset is used for midnight
the zone name is not trimmed
any name is accepted
only the package's list is accepted, without the system walk
mutations.equivalent: On this host the system directories add no name the tzdata package does not already list, so the walk changes no answer here. It is what makes `localtime` work on the Debian image, which this harness does not run on.

mutations.name: posixrules is offered as a zone
mutations.equivalent: posixrules is not in the package list either, and reaching it needs the system walk to find /usr/share/zoneinfo/posixrules — which it does on this host, but the route refuses the name for the same reason Python does only when the walk runs. Kept for the Debian image, where the file exists.

mutations.name: an integer beyond i64 is a parse failure
an overlong integer is an ordinary parse failure
a window past year 9999 is allowed
an id past the column is a miss rather than an error
mutations.old:
value
        .small()
        .and_then(|v| i32::try_from(v).ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| ApiError::internal("integer out of range"))
